question:
Find the incorrect part of the sentence:

The officer has issued an order to arrest him immediately.

options.text: an order to arrest him immediately

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence, "**The officer has issued an order to arrest him immediately**," is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Each part of the sentence has been analyzed, and no grammatical issues, structural inconsistencies, or errors in word usage are present.
 
• When no errors are found in the sentence, the correct choice is **Option 2: No error**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The officer has issued an order to arrest him immediately."*
